accumulator: u128; at most 64 products before reduction
hash_framing: TRNM-PON1\0, LE16 tag length, tag, then LE32 length and bytes for every part
noise: labels 0,1,2,3; H(noise,challenge,label,LE32(counter)); rejection-sampled LE32 words; 512 values per label
trace: SHA256(TRNM-PON-TRACE1\0 || challenge || LE32 cumulative cell values in bi,bj,bk,i,j order; 8x8 tiles)
ticket: H(ticket,challenge,trace) <= expected target as unsigned big-endian 256-bit integer
verification: bounded full replay of transcript and exact decoded product; no majority or approximate tolerances
known_limitations: cheap forged transcript can pass ticket filter and force expensive rejection
task-dependent decoding shortcuts and adversarial hardware speedup unqualified
uniform independent ticket/cost assumptions not proven
